standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, how can I help you? I'm sellin' if you have ecto- tokens.

options.text: Could I buy those chickens now, then?

steps.player: Could I buy those chickens now?

steps.npc: I can hand over a chicken if you give me 10 of them ecto-token thingies per bird.
Ta, some day soon I'll be havin' a nice undead bed to kip in.

steps.text: If the player does not have 10 Ecto-tokens

steps.npc: I'm not a charity here, ya know. Bad enough all you cow-killing folks are a'slaughterin' me beasts. Come back when ya have enough tokens.
Great! I'm laying away me tokens for some killer cows. That'll learn them bone rustlers.

steps.text: If the player does not have 20 Ecto-tokens

options.text: Your animals don't look too healthy; I'll buy elsewhere.

steps.npc: Har har, how many ghost chicky farmers d'you know, den?

options.text: Your animals don't look too healthy.

steps.player: Your animals don't look too healthy.

steps.npc: It's that fountain thingy in the temple to the east. It's turned them all into zombies.
None at all, mate, except that those worshippers at that temple keep comin' and killin' 'em all for their bones. Don't ask me why.

steps.player: But you're a ghost - surely you know something about it.

steps.npc: I don't know nuthin' about nuthin'. Oim a simple ghost with simple needs. All I know is, years ago, that temple started glowing green and, a few months later, I woke up dead. That's all there is to it.

options.text: Where can I get these ecto-tokens?

steps.npc: The ghosts I talk to say that the tokens have something to do with the tower just east of here. If you need to collect some I'd try there.

using-items-on-malcolm-undead-chicken.npc: I sells but I dunt be a-buyin'.

using-items-on-malcolm-any-other-item.npc: Wot use is that there stuff to a ghosty like meself?
